svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Buy a 120 mm cast or steel handwheel with a spinner knob and a hub

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: about 40 mm across and 30 mm long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bore the hub to take a round Tr20 x 4 nut (bronze or steel) as a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: press fit; or weld a steel hex nut into the hub, square to its face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pin the nut with a 4 mm pin across the hub if it is pressed in.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Face the hub's bottom flat so it bears evenly on the thrust washer.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: sits on a 2 mm thrust washer on the base plate, round the screw.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Turning it raises or lowers the table 4 mm a turn.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The rim is 2.5 mm clear of the column. Reach it under the shield front.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the table runs the full 100 mm with light hand force.
